verdicts.reason: A: the headline sits in the top third and the CTA pill is shrunk to a tiny bottom-left corner, with a huge dead orange void in between; the CTA and LIMITED badge are cut off from the message, and the badge has moved from before the button to after it, so the CTA looks like an afterthought. B: the headline at least fills the portrait canvas with intent, but it is oversized and choppy at one or two words per line; the CTA is far too small next to it and crammed close to the last line, and the LIMITED badge floats loose to the right instead of sitting beside the button.
